Findings.Description: Validate method accesses options.IlcPackages without null check; if options.IlcPackages is null a NullReferenceException will be thrown.
Findings.Recommendation: Add a null check before iterating and accessing Count on options.IlcPackages.
Findings.QuickFix: Add if (options.IlcPackages == null) return false; before the foreach loop.

Findings.Description: Method Validate has cyclomatic complexity of 30, far exceeding the target of <10, making it hard to understand and maintain.
Findings.Recommendation: Refactor Validate by extracting validation steps into separate private methods.
Findings.CodeSnippet: public static (bool success, Config config) Validate(CommandLineOptions options, ILogger logger) { ... }
Findings.QuickFix: Extract each validation block into its own method and call them from Validate.

Findings.Description:
[SecurityAgent]: The tool only checks that each provided IlcPackages path exists, without validating that the directory actually contains a legitimate ILCompiler package structure, allowing an attacker to supply a malicious directory that could be loaded and executed.

[PerformanceAgent]: Iterates over `options.IlcPackages` and calls `IsNotNullButDoesNotExist()` for each entry, performing a separate filesystem existence check per path; with many paths this adds O(N) I/O latency.
Findings.Recommendation:
Validate that each IlcPackages directory contains the expected ILCompiler package files (e.g., required DLLs or manifest) before accepting it.
Batch existence checks or cache results if the same path may be validated multiple times.
Findings.QuickFix: Add verification of required ILCompiler files inside each ilcPackages directory on line 332.

Findings.Description: Method CreateJobForGivenRuntime has cyclomatic complexity of 13, exceeding the recommended maximum of 10.
Findings.Recommendation: Break the method into smaller functions handling runtime parsing, job creation, and option application.
Findings.CodeSnippet: private static Job CreateJobForGivenRuntime(string runtime, CommandLineOptions options, ILogger logger) { ... }
Findings.QuickFix: Extract runtime parsing and job configuration into separate helper methods.

Findings.Description: Method Expand has cyclomatic complexity of 12, above the acceptable threshold.
Findings.Recommendation: Decompose Expand into smaller methods that handle each expansion scenario.
Findings.CodeSnippet: private static (bool success, Config config) Expand(string[] args, ILogger logger) { ... }
Findings.QuickFix: Split the logic for argument parsing, validation, and job creation into distinct methods.

Findings.Description: Class CommandLineOptions contains 76 members, violating the Single Responsibility Principle and making the class hard to maintain.
Findings.Recommendation: Group related options into separate option classes or structs and compose them in CommandLineOptions.
Findings.QuickFix: Create dedicated option groups (e.g., NativeAotOptions, RunOptions) and replace the flat list of properties.

Findings.Description: When multiple IlcPackages paths are supplied, duplicate paths are not detected, potentially creating redundant jobs.
Findings.Recommendation: Add a check for duplicate directory entries and reject or deduplicate them.
Findings.QuickFix: Validate that options.IlcPackages contains distinct paths before proceeding.
